title: Enhance Readability: Master CSS 'text-underline-offset' for Superior Underlines
tweet: Stop ugly underlines! Learn CSS 'text-underline-offset' to prevent descender overlaps & boost UI readability. Elevate your web typography game! #CSSTypography #UIDesign #WebFonts #UX
tip: Default browser underlines often cut through descenders (g, j, p, q, y), making text harder to read. Use 'text-underline-offset' to precisely position underlines, ensuring clean typography and a superior user experience, especially crucial with diverse web fonts. Combine with 'text-decoration-thickness' for full control.
css_snippet: a { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; /* Adjust to lift underline above descenders */ text-decoration-thickness: 1px; /* Control thickness for better legibility */ color: #007bff; /* Example link color */ }
